attBesluta.text: I took a chance for my first purchase on this brand site called "Vevor". This mesh cargo net arrived un good shape and at a speedy delivery. I was not sure if the quality was there or not but bought it anyway, and the price was MUCH cheaper when compared top other very similar products. It is a top quality cargo net, and fits my short bed RAM truck just fine. The straps are very strong, the extra shady mesh in the middle area is strong, and the 1 inch holes all along the edges allows the net to be hooked up according to the truck bed load. I am very p[leased and truly do recommend this product =- can't get any better.
Bought 4 of these for moving. They held up great, kept stuff from shifting around. Now I use one in back yard as a makeshift hammock.

I haul a load every other week and used a cheap plastic tarp the first time and it was wrecked after the hour long trip. Have used these ever since and haven’t had an issue since. Hint: fold them up to a third the width and then roll them up and they are super easy to store and to unroll for the next time. The cam straps included make this job very easy. Only wish is that they were about a foot longer for my application
Works great very heavy duty webbing and comes with clips and strap to secure load into place will last for years, use it on flat bed trailer.

I bought this for a friend as a gift to use on his small deck flatbed so he doesn't have to haul straps out for every little thing he puts on the deck. Bought this so he could unstrap the back flip it forward throw stuff on put the net over it pull tight drive away. Would be useful if it had more straps I got some more permanent, though inconvenient straps for the front where he rarely needs to adjust the length. I do wish it had a few more gromets for different strapping applications or odd shaped items. Lastly though this does have thick sturdy netting and the cross woven support straps the support straps are not actually attached to the netting except on the outside of the netting. we may have someone stitch the support straps to the netting in the future. Most of all throwing this over a load will keep the DOT happy an unstrapped wheelbarrow can draw you a ticket, but with a load tarp over it they are far less likely to bother you. All around good load securing tarp.
I wish there be more o-rings along the 8' length to tie to and three rows per side.
Heavy construction, great for what I'm using it for good product.Thank you very much.It will get lots of use
Arrived well packed and in good shape. Good value for what you get. Can't fault it for the price.
